How to change modes on Oral-B iO Series 3?
1.	Turn the brush on with the power button.
2.	While it’s running, briefly press the mode (lower) button to cycle through the available modes (each press advances to the next mode).
3.	Stop pressing when you have the desired mode; the brush will use that mode until you change it.
What is the difference between Oral-B iO Series 2 and 3?
The primary differences between the Oral-B iO Series 2 and 3 are the pressure sensor feedback and user interface. Other differences include:
Display/indicator: Series 3 uses a more visible light ring/handle indicator, while Series 2 uses a simpler indicator.
User interface: Series 3 makes pressure feedback easier to see during brushing, while Series 2 has a more basic interface.
Modes: Both offer three cleaning modes.
Pressure feedback: Series 3 has a 360 degree Smart Light Ring that shows when you’re brushing too hard, not hard enough, or just right, while Series 2 provides simpler pressure feedback for overbrushing.
How many cleaning modes does the Oral-B iO Series 3 have?
The Oral-B iO Series 3 has three cleaning modes: Daily Clean, Sensitive, and Whitening.
How to reset Oral-B iO toothbrush Series 3?
To reset the Oral-B iO Series 3 toothbrush, follow these steps:
1.	Turn the brush off.
2.	Press and hold the power button for about 10 seconds.
3.	Wait until it reboots.
What brush head is included in Oral-B iO Series 3?
The Oral-B Ultimate Clean Replacement Brush Head is included with the Oral-B iO Series 3.
Is the charger for the iO Series 3 compatible with older Oral-B Pro or Genius handles?
No. The iO Series 3 charger is not compatible with older Oral-B Pro or Genius handles. The iO uses a different charging base than the older Pro/Genius chargers, so they won’t charge each other. Use the charger designed for each model.
Does the Oral-B iO Series 3 have the same magnetic drive motor as the more expensive iO models?
Yes. The iO Series 3 uses Oral-B’s iO magnetic technology, including a linear motor drive and magnetic coupling. Higher-end iO models may differ in features, user interface, modes, accessories, and finish.

sections.heading: How to change modes on Oral-B iO Series 3?
sections.text: 1.	Turn the brush on with the power button. 2.	While it’s running, briefly press the mode (lower) button to cycle through the available modes (each press advances to the next mode). 3.	Stop pressing when you have the desired mode; the brush will use that mode until you change it.

sections.heading: What is the difference between Oral-B iO Series 2 and 3?
sections.text:
The primary differences between the Oral-B iO Series 2 and 3 are the pressure sensor feedback and user interface. Other differences include:
Display/indicator: Series 3 uses a more visible light ring/handle indicator, while Series 2 uses a simpler indicator.
User interface: Series 3 makes pressure feedback easier to see during brushing, while Series 2 has a more basic interface.
Modes: Both offer three cleaning modes.
Pressure feedback: Series 3 has a 360 degree Smart Light Ring that shows when you’re brushing too hard, not hard enough, or just right, while Series 2 provides simpler pressure feedback for overbrushing.

sections.heading: How many cleaning modes does the Oral-B iO Series 3 have?
sections.text: The Oral-B iO Series 3 has three cleaning modes: Daily Clean, Sensitive, and Whitening.

sections.heading: How to reset Oral-B iO toothbrush Series 3?
sections.text: To reset the Oral-B iO Series 3 toothbrush, follow these steps: 1.	Turn the brush off. 2.	Press and hold the power button for about 10 seconds. 3.	Wait until it reboots.

sections.heading: What brush head is included in Oral-B iO Series 3?
sections.text: The Oral-B Ultimate Clean Replacement Brush Head is included with the Oral-B iO Series 3.

sections.heading: Is the charger for the iO Series 3 compatible with older Oral-B Pro or Genius handles?
sections.text: No. The iO Series 3 charger is not compatible with older Oral-B Pro or Genius handles. The iO uses a different charging base than the older Pro/Genius chargers, so they won’t charge each other. Use the charger designed for each model.

sections.heading: Does the Oral-B iO Series 3 have the same magnetic drive motor as the more expensive iO models?
sections.text:
Yes. The iO Series 3 uses Oral-B’s iO magnetic technology, including a linear motor drive and magnetic coupling. Higher-end iO models may differ in features, user interface, modes, accessories, and finish.
